title: Cash Flow — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21). M GROWN 1 -> 3 on 2026-07-29 (Rule 21): the landing route verified live, which revealed 2 further tabs inside it. Counting the module complete on its landing surface alone would have been a wave-slice close.
